license_required.quote: No person shall operate, conduct, maintain, or profess to be an emergency medical services agency without a valid license issued by the Commissioner for such emergency medical services agency and a valid permit for each emergency medical services vehicle used by such emergency medical services agency.

issuing_authority.value: Commissioner of Health / Office of Emergency Medical Services
issuing_authority.quote: Each person desiring certification as an emergency medical services provider shall apply to the Commissioner upon a form prescribed by the Board.

name.quote: "Office of Emergency Medical Services" means the Office of Emergency Medical Services of the Department.

type.quote: "Office of Emergency Medical Services" means the Office of Emergency Medical Services of the Department.

umbrella_agency.quote: The Board of Health shall develop a Statewide Emergency Medical Services Plan

required.quote: Such regulations shall include criteria for determining whether an applicant's relevant practical experience and didactic and clinical components of education and training completed during his service as a member of any branch of the armed forces of the United States may be accepted by the Commissioner as evidence of satisfaction of the requirements for certification.

experience_source.quote: The Board shall prescribe by regulation the qualifications required for certification of emergency medical services providers

exams.name: EMS provider certification examination
exams.notes: The Commissioner shall cause the applicant to be examined or otherwise determined to be qualified for certification; specific exam not named in statute.
exams.quote: Upon receipt of such application, the Commissioner shall cause the applicant to be examined or otherwise determined to be qualified for certification.

interval_years.quote: Licenses and permits shall be valid for a period specified by the Board, not to exceed two years.

required.quote: Emergency medical services personnel who receive mental health awareness training in accordance with this section shall receive appropriate continuing education credits from the Office of Emergency Medical Services.

topical_requirements.quote: Emergency medical services personnel who receive mental health awareness training in accordance with this section shall receive appropriate continuing education credits from the Office of Emergency Medical Services.

available.quote: an emergency medical services provider who holds a valid license or certification in a state that borders the Commonwealth may provide emergency medical services in the Commonwealth if (i) such services are provided at a widely attended event open to the public

requirements.value: Out-of-state EMS providers from bordering states may practice at widely attended public events when local capacity is exceeded, with advance notice and credential information provided to the Commissioner. Interstate compact members are governed by compact provisions.
requirements.quote: The provisions of this section shall not be construed to supersede or affect the provisions of Chapter 18 (§ 32.1-371) or any other interstate agreement regarding emergency medical services providers.

exists.quote: "Advisory Board" means the State Emergency Medical Services Advisory Board.

name.value: State Emergency Medical Services Advisory Board
name.quote: "Advisory Board" means the State Emergency Medical Services Advisory Board.

authority.value: The Advisory Board assists in design and implementation of the EMS Registry, develops trauma triage criteria, reviews data quarterly and reports findings to the Commissioner, and consults with the Board on training, certification, and recertification requirements.
authority.quote: Requirements, developed in consultation with the Advisory Board, governing the training, certification, and recertification of emergency medical services personnel

national_certification.value: National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians
national_certification.quote: the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall operate, conduct, maintain, or profess to be an emergency medical services agency without a valid license issued by the Commissioner for such emergency medical services agency and a valid permit for each emergency medical services vehicle used by such emergency medical services agency.

credential_type.quote: "Emergency medical services provider" or "EMS provider" means any person who holds a valid certificate as an emergency medical services provider issued by the Commissioner.

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall operate, conduct, maintain, or profess to be an emergency medical services agency without a valid license issued by the Commissioner

title_protection.quote: The word "ambulance" shall not appear on any vehicle, vessel, or aircraft that does not hold a valid permit as an emergency medical services vehicle.

scope_protection.quote: No person shall operate, conduct, maintain, or profess to be an emergency medical services agency without a valid license issued by the Commissioner for such emergency medical services agency and a valid permit for each emergency medical services vehicle used by such emergency medical services agency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Operating in violation of any provision of the EMS article or applicable regulation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Whenever an emergency medical services agency or emergency medical services vehicle owned or operated by an emergency medical services agency is in violation of any provision of this article or any applicable regulation, the Commissioner shall have power to revoke or suspend such emergency medical services agency's license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Finding of substantial danger to public health or safety warranting temporary suspension without notice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The Commissioner may temporarily suspend any license for an emergency medical services agency or permit for an emergency medical services vehicle without notice, pending a hearing or informal fact-finding conference, if the Commissioner finds that there is a substantial danger to public health or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: EMS provider certificate may be suspended when holder no longer meets qualifications
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any certificate so issued may be suspended at any time that the Commissioner determines that the holder no longer meets the qualifications prescribed for such emergency medical services provider.

insurance_required.quote: Set minimum limits of liability insurance coverage for emergency medical services vehicles

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Each emergency medical services agency for which a license has been issued and emergency medical services vehicle for which a permit has been issued shall be inspected as often as the Commissioner deems necessary and a record thereof shall be maintained.

definition_quote.value: "Emergency medical services" or "EMS" means health care, public health, and public safety services used in the medical response to the real or perceived need for immediate medical assessment, care, or transportation and preventive care or transportation in order to prevent loss of life or aggravation of physiological or psychological illness or injury.
definition_quote.quote: "Emergency medical services" or "EMS" means health care, public health, and public safety services used in the medical response to the real or perceived need for immediate medical assessment, care, or transportation and preventive care or transportation in order to prevent loss of life or aggravation of physiological or psychological illness or injury.

methods_authorized.quote: health care, public health, and public safety services used in the medical response to the real or perceived need for immediate medical assessment, care, or transportation and preventive care or transportation in order to prevent loss of life or aggravation of physiological or psychological illness or injury

drug_authority.value: EMS personnel at certain certification levels may possess and administer epinephrine or medically accepted equivalent for emergency anaphylactic shock, and oxygen with authority of local operational medical director.
drug_authority.quote: Authorization procedures, developed in consultation with the Advisory Board, that allow the possession and administration of epinephrine or a medically accepted equivalent for emergency cases of anaphylactic shock by certain levels of certified emergency medical services personnel as authorized by § 54.1-3408 and authorization procedures that allow the possession and administration of oxygen with the authority of the local operational medical director

community_paramedicine_authorized.quote: Procedures for when emergency medical services agencies in medically underserved areas as defined by the Board may transport patients to 24-hour urgent care facilities or appropriate medical care facilities other than hospitals.

medical_director_required.quote: "Operational medical director" or "OMD" means an EMS physician, currently licensed to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine in the Commonwealth, who is formally recognized and responsible for providing medical direction, oversight, and quality improvement to an EMS agency.

standing_orders_authorized.quote: Authorization procedures, developed in consultation with the Advisory Board, that allow the possession and administration of epinephrine or a medically accepted equivalent for emergency cases of anaphylactic shock by certain levels of certified emergency medical services personnel as authorized by § 54.1-3408 and authorization procedures that allow the possession and administration of oxygen with the authority of the local operational medical director and an emergency medical services agency that holds a valid license issued by the Commissioner

protocol_approval_process.value: Board of Health prescribes regulations in consultation with the Advisory Board governing training, certification, and operational procedures including authorization for medications.
protocol_approval_process.quote: Requirements, developed in consultation with the Advisory Board, governing the training, certification, and recertification of emergency medical services personnel

ambulance_service_license_required.quote: No person shall operate, conduct, maintain, or profess to be an emergency medical services agency without a valid license issued by the Commissioner for such emergency medical services agency and a valid permit for each emergency medical services vehicle used by such emergency medical services agency.

ambulance_vehicle_inspection_required.quote: Each emergency medical services agency for which a license has been issued and emergency medical services vehicle for which a permit has been issued shall be inspected as often as the Commissioner deems necessary and a record thereof shall be maintained.

minimum_staffing_requirements.value: The Board shall classify emergency medical services agencies and emergency medical services vehicles by type of service rendered and shall specify the medical equipment, the supplies, the vehicle specifications, and the emergency medical services personnel required for each classification.
minimum_staffing_requirements.quote: The Board shall classify emergency medical services agencies and emergency medical services vehicles by type of service rendered and shall specify the medical equipment, the supplies, the vehicle specifications, and the emergency medical services personnel required for each classification.

regional_ems_council_structure.quote: The Board shall designate regional emergency medical services councils that shall be authorized to receive and disburse public funds. Each such council shall be charged with the development and implementation of an efficient and effective regional emergency medical services delivery system.

trauma_system_designation.quote: Establishing and maintaining a process for designation of appropriate hospitals as trauma centers, certified stroke centers, and specialty care centers based on an applicable national evaluation system

service_zone_or_primary_service_area_sys.quote: The governing bodies of the several counties or cities of the Commonwealth may create and establish, by designation on a map of the county or city showing current, official parcel boundaries, or by any other description that is legally sufficient for the conveyance of property or the creation of parcels, emergency medical services zones or districts

interstate_compact_member.quote: Any out-of-state emergency medical services provider who holds a license or certification in a state that has entered into an interstate compact of which the Commonwealth is a member or any other interstate agreement with the Commonwealth regarding emergency medical services providers shall be governed by the provisions of such compact or agreement.

military_veteran_licensure_pathway.quote: Such regulations shall include criteria for determining whether an applicant's relevant practical experience and didactic and clinical components of education and training completed during his service as a member of any branch of the armed forces of the United States may be accepted by the Commissioner as evidence of satisfaction of the requirements for certification.

criminal_background_check_required.quote: The Board shall require each person who, on or after July 1, 2013, applies to be a volunteer with or employee of an emergency medical services agency to submit fingerprints and provide personal descriptive information to be forwarded along with his fingerprints through the Central Criminal Records Exchange to the Federal Bureau of Investigation, for the purpose of obtaining his criminal history record information.

mental_health_training_required.quote: Each emergency medical services agency shall develop curricula for mental health awareness training for its personnel, which shall include training regarding the following: 1. Understanding signs and symptoms of cumulative stress, depression, anxiety, exposure to acute and chronic trauma, compulsive behaviors, and addiction

epinephrine_administration_authorized.quote: Authorization procedures, developed in consultation with the Advisory Board, that allow the possession and administration of epinephrine or a medically accepted equivalent for emergency cases of anaphylactic shock by certain levels of certified emergency medical services personnel as authorized by § 54.1-3408

aed_program_regulated.quote: "Automated external defibrillator" means a medical device which combines a heart monitor and defibrillator and (i) has been approved by the United States Food and Drug Administration

alternate_destination_transport_authoriz.quote: Procedures for when emergency medical services agencies in medically underserved areas as defined by the Board may transport patients to 24-hour urgent care facilities or appropriate medical care facilities other than hospitals.

treatment_of_police_dogs_authorized.quote: The Advisory Board shall, in consultation with the Board of Veterinary Medicine, develop guidelines and guidance for the provision of emergency treatment of fire, police, and search and rescue dogs injured in the line of duty and the transportation of such dogs by an emergency medical services vehicle to a veterinary care facility equipped to provide emergency treatment to such dog.

ems_data_collection_required.quote: All licensed emergency medical services agencies shall participate in the Virginia EMS Registry by making available to the Commissioner or his designees the minimum data set in the format prescribed by the Board

quality_assurance_program_required.quote: A performance improvement program for monitoring the quality of emergency medical services and trauma services, consistent with other components of the Emergency Medical Services Plan.

emergency_medical_dispatcher_certificati.quote: Establishing and maintaining a program to improve dispatching of emergency medical services personnel and vehicles, including establishment of and support for emergency medical services dispatch training, accreditation of 911 dispatch centers, and public safety answering points

civil_immunity_for_good_faith_care.quote: No individual, licensed emergency medical services agency, hospital, Regional Emergency Medical Services Council or organization advising the Commissioner shall be liable for any civil damages resulting from any act or omission preformed as required by this article unless such act or omission was the result of gross negligence or willful misconduct.
